name: Jahath
overview: Jahath was a male descendant of Shimei from the tribe of Levi. His lineage is noted explicitly in Scripture, emphasizing his place within the Levitical family line. There are no additional notes provided about his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name Jahath means 'snatch up' in Hebrew. It is a proper name recorded in Scripture without indication that it was given directly by God, reflecting a typical Hebrew personal name of the period.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jahath as a descendant of Shimei, establishing his genealogical connection within the tribe of Levi. No other family relationships are documented beyond this lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Jahath's significance lies primarily in his genealogical mention, which contributes to the detailed record of Levitical families. This lineage underlines the continuity of the priestly tribe of Levi and God's preservation of His chosen people through generations. Although not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion affirms the faithfulness of God in maintaining His covenant community.
